title: Rooney 2009-10 v Kane 2017-18: England's best number nine season?
checked: Ronaldo sold to Real Madrid summer 2009 (Wikipedia United season, Wikipedia Ronaldo). Arsenal 1-3 United 31 Jan 2010, Rooney's 37th-minute counter-attack goal from Nani's return after a 70-metre run (Al Jazeera, Fox Sports; the BBC names Park). Rooney 26 league / 34 all comps, PFA and FWA awards 2010 (Wikipedia season, Wikipedia Rooney). League Cup final 28 Feb 2010, United 2-1 Villa, Rooney's headed winner (Wikipedia final). Bayern 2-1 United 30 Mar 2010, Rooney scored early and hurt his ankle at the end; United 1-2 Chelsea 3 Apr 2010 without him (Wikipedia season, BBC). Final table Chelsea 86, United 85 (Wikipedia). Drogba 29, Rooney 26 (Wikipedia). Kane: Spurs at Wembley 2017-18; 26 Dec 2017 hat-trick v Southampton, first goal a header from Eriksen's cross, 39 PL goals in 2017 beating Shearer's 36 (Tottenham FC, Goal.com, FourFourTwo). 30 league / 41 all comps; Eriksen's goal at Stoke given to Kane on appeal (BBC, Wikipedia Kane). Salah 32 Golden Boot; table City 100, United 81, Spurs 77 (Wikipedia). Gameplay: Rooney's counter and Kane's header recreated with gamecap (specs rooney-2010, kane-2017; United's black away kit is assumed).

lines.text: England's two greatest goalscorers. Their best seasons. One got a medal. One got a record.
lines.say: England's two greatest goalscorers. Their best seasons. One got a medal. One got a record.

lines.text: Summer 2009. Ronaldo leaves for Real Madrid, and Wayne Rooney becomes United's main man.
lines.say: Summer, twenty oh nine. Ronaldo leaves for Rayal Madrid, and Wayne Rooney becomes United's main man.

lines.text: At Arsenal, he starts a counter in his own half, sprints seventy metres, and finishes it.
lines.say: At Arsenal, he starts a counter in his own half, sprints seventy metres, and finishes it.

lines.text: Twenty-six league goals, thirty-four in all. Both Player of the Year awards.
lines.say: Twenty-six league goals, thirty-four in all. Both Player of the Year awards.

lines.text: In February, he heads the winner in the League Cup final.
lines.say: In February, he heads the winner in the League Cup final.

lines.text: Then Munich. He scores early, and wrecks his ankle in the last minute.

scene.note: Rooney scores, then limps off injured

lines.say: Then Munich. He scores early, and wrecks his ankle in the last minute.

lines.text: Without him, United lose to Chelsea at Old Trafford. And the league, by one point.
lines.say: Without him, United lose to Chelsea at Old Trafford. And the league, by one point.

lines.text: 2017-18. Harry Kane on Boxing Day. A header from Eriksen's cross, the first of a hat-trick.
lines.say: Twenty seventeen, eighteen. Harry Kane on Boxing Day. A header from Erikson's cross, the first of a hat-trick.

lines.text: Thirty-nine Premier League goals in one calendar year. Shearer's record, gone.

scene.headline: Kane breaks Shearer's record
scene.standfirst: A hat-trick against Southampton takes him to 39 Premier League goals in 2017, three more than Shearer's 36.

lines.say: Thirty-nine Premier League goals in one calendar year. Sheerer's record, gone.

lines.text: Thirty league goals, forty-one in all. He even appealed to get one of Eriksen's goals. And won.
lines.say: Thirty league goals, forty-one in all. He even appealed to get one of Erikson's goals. And won.

lines.text: And Spurs finished third, twenty-three points behind City. No trophy.
lines.say: And Spurs finished third, twenty-three points behind City. No trophy.

lines.text: Kane wins on goals. Rooney wins on medals, and came one ankle away from more.
lines.say: Kane wins on goals. Rooney wins on medals, and came one ankle away from more.

lines.text: Kane scored more. Rooney came closer to everything. Settled: Rooney.
lines.say: Kane scored more. Rooney came closer to everything. Settled: Rooney.

lines.text: Follow for more, and play Road to Ballon d'Or.
